messages:
ashley: Heads up — EU ingest had a partial failover around 03:12 UTC overnight, looks like ~4 hours of model_serving telemetry dropped for a subset of shards. We need a safe rehydrate/backfill plan.
ben: Ugh. Which metrics exactly? aggregate_tokens and latency_p95?
achley: aggregate_tokens and request_counts mostly, and some route-level traces. latency metrics are intact.
ashley: Right. It's an ingest-side flap: a routing policy rollback triggered by autoscaling + transient kafka partitioning. Some events were acked locally but never made it to the telemetry pipeline.
chao: Do we have event ids to dedupe on replay? If not, backfill risk is double-counting aggregates.
ashley: We do — each ingest record has event_id and arrival_ts. Downstream parquet has them for the partial set. The problem is holes where no parquet was written.
eva: Proposal: we run a spot-backfill job that replays from raw S3 for timestamps [2026-03-02T03:00Z .. 2026-03-02T07:30Z] with idempotency by event_id and route. Throttle to respect user quotas.
frank: Throttle = important. Last time the replay saturated the Dedicated pools and caused tail latency spikes. We need quota-aware backfill that respects per-customer throughput.
chao: Can we reuse the recompute service with a new priority queue flag? e.g. priority=low, slo_cutoff=200ms to avoid impacting online traffic.
eva: Yes. I sketched a mode: --slo-priority=background, which sets concurrency to min(available-foreground, configured-background-cap). Also integrate token-bucket at per-model and per-tenant granularity.
ashley: Console UX ask: product wants a "Rehydrate" CTA on the telemetry dashboard that opens scheduling modal with time-range, dry-run checkbox, and a checkbox "respect quotas" (recommended). We need guardrails.
ben: For guardrails, let's enforce a default max throughput of 200 qps for dedicated and 50 qps for hosted by default. Override only with ops approval.
chao: Need to be careful with idempotency keys when recomputing aggregates that use windowed joins. We should dedupe before windowing: group by event_id, pick max(arrival_ts) per event_id, then feed into aggregator.
ashley: Good call. Also add a small canary: replay first 10 minutes to a canary partition, validate counts, then proceed.
frank: Operational plan: 1) Dry-run on staging with same data slice; 2) Canary 10m in prod to a canary compute job; 3) Ramp with doubling throttle every 30m until window cleared.
deploy-bot: job/telemetry-rehydrate-2107451234 queued by @ashley; will start when operator approves.
eva: Example k8s job snippet for the replay container for ops notes:
```
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: telemetry-rehydrate-2107451234
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: replayer
        image: redwood/replay:stable
        args: ["--start=2026-03-02T03:00Z","--end=2026-03-02T07:30Z","--mode=background","--dedupe-key=event_id","--throttle=200"]
      restartPolicy: Never
```
chao: Add --shard=canary and --validate-only for the dry-run step. Also capture sample outputs to a validation S3 prefix for QA.
ben: We should surface active rehydrate jobs in Console > Telemetry > Replays with live progress, expected completion ETA, and a "suspend" button. Ops asked for a circuit breaker that auto-suspends if tail latency > 2x baseline for 10m.
ashley: Agree. Also we must update the routing policy to avoid sending replays to Dedicated pools when Dedicated utilization > 70% even if they're marked as eligible. Fallback to burst-hosted or postpone.
frank: One more: billing/usage. Backfills should be billed as background compute and not count against customer usage quotas, but recorded for cost tracking. Need billing tag in job metadata.
eva: I'll draft the Console modal copy and the job metadata fields (owner, dry_run, billing_tag, quota_respected).
ashley: OK next steps: eva will open a PR with job runner changes + throttle hooks; chao will add dedupe-before-windowing; ben will design the Console modal and circuit breaker UI; frank will draft the runbook with SLO rollback triggers. I'll coordinate the ops approval.
chao: I'll also add an endpoint /replay/status that returns per-model throughput and injected-latency metrics for the circuit breaker to poll.
ashley: Thanks everyone. Filing this under the backfill runbook. Will ping when the PRs land. :thumbsup:
